Never store passwords client-side, period. **3. eval() Usage** (Line 125) `eval('window.trackSignup("' + formData.email + '")');` **Severity:** CRITICAL Using `eval()` with user input?! I'm gonna build my own auth system, with blackjack and NO EVAL! Arbitrary code execution vulnerability. **Fix:** `window.trackSignup?.(formData.email)` **4. URL Parameter Injection** (Line 155) `axios.get(`${API_URL}/auth/reset?email=${email}`)` **Severity:** HIGH Not encoding the email parameter. I could inject `email=foo@bar.com&admin=true` and wreak havoc! **Fix:** Use URLSearchParams properly **5. Client-Side Admin Check** (Lines 214-217) **Severity:** CRITICAL Checking admin status from LOCALSTORAGE?! I can just open DevTools and become admin! This is stupider than Fry! **Fix:** ALWAYS verify permissions server-side. Client checks are for UX only. ## HIGH SEVERITY ISSUES **6. No CSRF Protection** - All POST requests lack CSRF tokens **7.
